frozenMeaning: FROZEN 2026-08-21. This CSV is the 21,872-tile hand-authored planet and it is now AHEAD of the generator that first wrote it. Do NOT run src/RimMandrake/Utils/ashkarr_paint.py over it - that script takes no arguments, rebuilds tiles + settlements + links wholesale the moment it is invoked, and would silently regress every hand edit made since. The output would still be 21,872 valid rows with no error and no visible break, which is why this is a refusal rather than a comment.

whyItPassesTheThreeTests.a_human_decisions: The owner's rain ruling (RAIN_DRY_THE_LOWLANDS_1) zeroed rain_mm on 20,113 of 21,872 rows, and OCULAR_FOREST_SUMMITS_1 painted AB_OcularForest onto tiles 4299/9158/9159. Neither is reproducible by the painter - both are judgement calls recorded afterwards. Per CLAUDE.md the map is built BY HAND, ONCE, and frozen; this makes that doctrine true rather than hopeful.
whyItPassesTheThreeTests.b_generator_exists: ashkarr_paint.py. Measured 2026-08-21: a plain re-run regresses the 20,113 rain rows and the 3 ocular tiles.
whyItPassesTheThreeTests.c_hard_to_notice: The regenerated file is the same shape, the same 21,872 rows, and parses clean. The only symptom is a wet planet, and nobody diffs rain_mm by habit.

whatFreezingCosts: From now on the world is changed by SURGICAL edit, not by regeneration. That is already how it has been done - ashkarr_clamp_rain.py, ashkarr_regate_rain.py, ashkarr_fix_impassable.py, ashkarr_regrade_rivers.py and ashkarr_sink_scald.py each read the current CSV and change named rows, and NONE of them is frozen; they stay free on purpose. What is refused is the one script that rebuilds from scratch. If the planet ever genuinely needs regenerating from the paint, that is WORLD_REDRAFT_PROCEDURE_1's job and it should be written down before it is run, not discovered mid-run.
toUnfreeze: 1. Run the generator with its override flag - ashkarr_paint.py prints it in the refusal.
2. Set "frozen": false in this file, or delete this file.
notFrozenWhy: Only the tiles CSV is known to carry hand edits the painter would lose. ashkarr_paint.py writes the settlements and links CSVs too, so the guard stops those being rebuilt as a side effect - but they are not independently frozen and no separate claim is made about them. If one of them is later hand-edited, say so here.  ⚠️ 2026-08-23: world/ASHKARR_WORLDMAP_mutators.csv HAS now been hand-edited - ashkarr_shore_and_ice.py removed VEE_SaltPlains from the 170 tiles that became AridShrubland, dropping those rows entirely (6700 -> 6530) because the file's convention is one row per tile that HAS mutators. Saying so here, as this field asks.
restampedWhy: Restamped 2026-08-22 after an independent audit found this file 16 hours stale and STRUCTURALLY UNABLE to notice: it asserted '20,113 rows with rain_mm = 0' (actual at the time: 20,476) and carried no hash and no row count, so the claim read as authoritative while being false. sha256/rows/bytes are the fix - a freeze that cannot detect its own staleness is a comment, not a guard.  Restamped again 2026-08-23 by DECIDE after ashkarr_shore_and_ice.py - a SURGICAL edit of the class this freeze explicitly leaves free - changed 447 biome values (369 drained-seabed tiles zoned into AridShrubland/Desert/ExtremeDesert, 92 water tiles re-decided across the ice margin). Only the `biome` column moved; rows, elevation, water and region are untouched. The hash is restamped because a stale hash is exactly the failure this marker was rewritten to prevent.  🔴 AND THE GUARD HAD ALREADY BEEN BYPASSED ONCE: the stamped bytes read 1848464 while the file on disk was 1751503 - 96,961 bytes stale - so a surgical edit had landed between 2026-08-22 and now WITHOUT restamping. Nothing reported it, because nothing checks. ⇒ The stamp is only a guard if something VERIFIES it; whoever next touches this file should make the check a command rather than a habit.  Restamped 2026-09-06 by FOUNDRY (TILES_STAMP_VERIFY_1) after the stamp was found stale a THIRD time — stamped 65c7be19 (blob of 0ccf44fe) vs disk b38fd685 (blob of 609d2ea5). The delta is 15 surgical commits, all 2026-08-23, e3eb2882..609d2ea5; the largest by far is e3eb2882 'The nightside becomes layers: mycoid, then horror wastes, then alien chemistry' (2,903 of the 4,264 changed biomes: AB_RockyCrags -> HorrorWastes x1423 / AB_PropaneLakes x899 / BMT_CrystalCaverns x376). Each commit's diff line count equals its measured biome-change count exactly, so every one is a SURGICAL edit and NOT a paint regeneration. The two hand-decisions this freeze exists to protect are byte-identical across the whole window: rain_mm=0 on 20,476 rows, and AB_OcularForest on 3 tiles. ⚠️ The filing's headline — a '~1650-tile shrubland->Desert repaint' — DOES NOT EXIST on this file: AridShrubland -> Desert occurs on ZERO rows, and the net move is the opposite direction (Desert -497, AridShrubland +39). That language belongs to WORLDMAP_DESERT_BAND_REPAIR_1, which is still `proposed`, is measured against world/ASHKARR_VIVIFIED_2026-08-24_tiles.csv, and has landed nowhere. 🔑 The 'nothing checks' gap named above is now closed in BOTH directions: verify_frozen.warn_if_stale() is called by every in-process READER of this CSV, and every surgical WRITER of it now prints the --restamp command after it writes.
